desc: A century of isolation and absolute rule.

events.title: The Kot Massacre
events.desc: Jung Bahadur Rana seizes power in a bloody coup at the palace armory, initiating 104 years of hereditary rule.

events.title: The Revolution Begins
events.desc: The Nepali Congress launches an armed struggle to overthrow the Ranas, supported by King Tribhuvan.

desc: A brief glimmer of hope before the shadows returned.

events.title: Dawn of Democracy
events.desc: King Tribhuvan returns, ending Rana rule. A coalition government is formed.

events.title: The First Election
events.desc: B.P. Koirala becomes the first democratically elected Prime Minister in a landslide victory.

desc: Silence falls. The King takes absolute control.

events.title: The Royal Coup
events.desc: King Mahendra dissolves parliament, arrests B.P. Koirala, and bans political parties.

events.title: The Referendum
events.desc: Student protests force a referendum on the Panchayat system, which survives by a narrow, rigged margin.

desc: A decade of fire and blood.

events.title: The Insurgency Begins
events.desc: The Maoists launch an armed rebellion in Rolpa and Rukum, demanding a republic.

events.title: The Royal Massacre
events.desc: King Birendra and his family are gunned down during a dinner gathering. Crown Prince Dipendra is blamed.

desc: A new dawn, still chasing stability.

events.title: Monarchy Abolished
events.desc: The Constituent Assembly declares Nepal a Federal Democratic Republic. The Shah dynasty ends.

events.title: The Constitution
events.desc: After years of delay and devastating earthquakes, a new constitution is finally promulgated.
